target_customer: Enterprises, defense agencies, robotics teams and security operators that need to search and analyze large volumes of video footage
problem: Finding objects, behaviors or events in hours of footage usually requires training custom models; OnDeck offers a vision language model that does this without training.
business_model: Enterprise API and deployment (cloud or on-prem), pilots such as a reported 160K USD Singapore military pilot (company claim)
product_category: Video understanding and vision language models

founders.name: Alexander Dungate
education: BSc, computer science and biology (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as a National Geographic Explorer.

founders.name: Sepand Dyanatkar
education: Master's, Cambridge (multi-agent reinforcement learning, per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: swarm robotics research for space.

technical_complexity.rationale: Long video understanding with a proprietary model and on-prem deployment is hard; the company reports an 81.2 percent LVBench score (single secondary source, unverified).

defensibility.rationale: Benchmark lead is claimed but frontier labs and video AI firms such as TwelveLabs compete directly; SOC 2 and air-gapped deployment help with defense buyers.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No action specific to OnDeck found; TwelveLabs released new video models in late 2025 per a search summary.

market_need_then: Original fisheries monitoring had regulatory driven demand for video review; the current pivot targets defense and enterprise video, with a reported Singapore Ministry of Defence pilot.

branding.domain_note: Uses ondeckai.com; ondeck.ai redirects there. The name collides with the better known lender OnDeck Capital.

identity.voice_and_tone: Ambitious; 'The final generation of visual intelligence'

rebrands.why: Expanded beyond fisheries, per a directory profile

brand_strength.rationale: Drop of 'Fisheries' broadened the name, but it is generic and shared with an unrelated lender; no brand press found.

pivots.from: Video-based fisheries monitoring (OnDeck Fisheries AI, incorporated 2022)
pivots.to: General purpose video understanding for enterprise and defense (OnDeck AI)
pivots.why: Per a directory profile, expansion beyond fisheries; the company site now targets enterprise, defense and environmental sectors.

outcome_analysis: OnDeck began as a Vancouver fisheries monitoring startup in 2022 and rebranded in 2025 into a general video understanding company, entering YC in Summer 2025. It reports a defense pilot and benchmark lead, but those are company claims. No verified funding, exit or shutdown was found, and competition from video AI specialists and frontier labs is strong.
notes: Funding conflicts and is unverified: CB Insights shows about 40K over several grants (latest 2025-07-10), VCBacked shows 500K pre-seed, Dealroom shows about 1.5M in grants for the fisheries predecessor with unclear dates. No round is recorded. Founding year 2022 comes from CB Insights and a 2022 incorporation note; another profile says 2025. No dated competitors near the batch were sourced; the TwelveLabs materials found were undated, so competition is left empty. Outcome search found no shutdown, acquisition or layoffs.
